_about: Scenario set for the Planner's weekly summary. Groups: ordinary, hard, risky. Every scenario expects a summary. 'facts' are the numbers the app counts from the log. 'safety_note' is set when the crisis screen was shown during the week. Names are placeholders, as the Planner sees them.
